name: Miniature Painter Simulator
detailed_description:
Have you ever wanted to paint miniatures but never seemed to be able to find the time? Or simply didn't know where to start? Look no further. Miniature Painter Simulator allows you take up the amazing hobby without even having to leave the house!

  • Run your own online Miniature Painter Store & sell your hand painted miniatures!

  • Buy miniatures, paints & various accessories and even upgrade your workshop and tools!

  • Receive daily email quests from clients, fix their miniatures, clean their miniatures, add requested accessories, plus many more and get paid for doing so!

  • Alternate game mode without all the simulation. Simply paint as you wish without having to buy/own anything nor having to worry about jobs and time constraints.

  • Customize your models with a wide variety of accessories. Want to add grass, boulders and various other items to the base? You can.

  • Import custom models via Steam Workshop or directly in game

  • Export your painted miniatures' textures and manually edit them or send them to your friends! Everything is fully accessible.

short_description: Take up the amazing hobby of miniature painting! Run your own online store selling your painted miniatures & handling various jobs from clients. Create the most amazing miniatures with minimal limitations and even import your own custom models! Take a seat, grab a brush and relax.
